description:
gen.py at pkix-identity/tests/fixtures/gen.py:52 calls ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1()) per cert. Each run produces fixture .der bytes that differ from the committed copy at the key + signature level.

Consequence: any contributor who regenerates fixtures (e.g., to add a new SAN combination) will see the unrelated fixtures churn in git. Reviewer cannot tell from the diff whether a fixture's SAN content changed or only its key.

Suggested rewrite: seed deterministically. Two clean options:
- Hardcode a fixed PEM key for self-signed leaf signing.
- Use ec.derive_private_key(int, ec.SECP256R1()) with a per-fixture stable scalar.

Not blocking — the fixture .der files are committed and tests are offline regardless. But the next contributor who runs gen.py will produce a noisy diff.
title: tests/fixtures/gen.py uses fresh ec keys each run (non-deterministic byte-level fixtures)
